name: Tsumugu Logic
source:
Tsumugu Taki moved from his hometown to Nagoya after graduating high school. For now, all he knows is that he doesn't see himself as a blue-collar worker, so he decided to attend college.  
  
He soon meets Sousei Morotomiya, a grumpy long-haired man with a sharp mind, and has a fateful reencounter with Kotoko Yotsutsuji, his old high school crush. His new life is, also, somewhat full of mysteries.

The three of them will try to solve the riddles around them in their (ab)normal daily lives.

New encounters, enternal farewells.

What will remain in the boy's hand when the "infinite possibilities" end?

---

This is the 5th title in SEEC's Escape Novel series
translation:
泷嗣高中毕业后从家乡搬到了名古屋。目前，他只知道自己并不认为自己是一名蓝领工人，因此他决定上大学。
  
他很快遇到了脾气暴躁、头脑敏锐的长发男子诸富宫创成，并与他高中时暗恋的四辻琴子命运般地重逢。他的新生活也充满了谜团。

他们三人将尝试解决他们（不正常）日常生活中围绕着他们的谜题。

新的相遇，内心的告别。

当“无限的可能性”结束时，男孩手中会剩下什么？

---

这是SEEC逃脱小说系列的第五部作品
